# Your Huckleberry (@huckleberry.inn), Nungambakkam, Chennai

> Bespoke 100% Pure Vegetarian & Eggless Haute Pâtisserie in Thousand Lights / Nungambakkam, Chennai. Handcrafted Victorian Lambeth celebration cakes, Miniature Couture gift sets, December Christmas Plum Cakes, Corporate Gifting Hampers, and daily gourmet desserts.
